sw.A price of your own for a customer, whic: Bei yako mwenyewe ya mteja, inayozidi bei ngazi za kiasi.
sw.A price that applies from a certain quan: Bei inayotumika kuanzia kiasi fulani, ili kununua zaidi kuzunguze bei ya kila kimoja.
sw.A running list of stock that is close to: Orodha ya moja kwa moja ya stocki karibia kumalika, iliyo karibia zaidi kwanza.
sw.Dispenses medicine safely: batches with: Inatoa dawa kwa usalama: batchi zenye tarehe za kumalika, mapishi yenye jina la mwandishi, na stocki inayotolewa kwa mpangilio wa kumalika.
sw.Find a product at the till by scanning i: Tafuta bidhaa kwenye kasa kwa kuskana msimu wake wa nyaraka badala ya kuandika jina.
sw.Fire an order to the kitchen and track i: Peleka oda kulinishi na ufuatilie mpaka imeiva na kusambazwa.
sw.Follow every order from the moment it is: Fuatilia kila oda tangu inapelekwa hadi inaposambazwa.
sw.Keep the menu, mark an item sold out, an: Weka menyu, onyesha kitu kimeisha na kukificha kwenye kasa hadi kirudi.
sw.Know which batch of which product is on: Jua bidhaa gani, batchi gani, kwenye rafiki na kimebaki.
sw.Open a tab on a table, add to it, and cl: Fungua kadi kwenye meza, ongeza kwenye hiyo, na funga pale meza ilipoplika.
sw.Record the prescriber, dispense against: Rekodi mwandishi wa dawa, toa kwa batchi, na hifadhi rekodi.
sw.Require a barcode on new products: Hitaji msimu wa nyaraka kwenye bidhaa mpya
sw.Require the prescriber's number: Hitaji namba ya mwandishi wa dawa
sw.Run multi-buy and threshold promotions,: Endesha promosheni za kununua nyingi na za kizingiti, na utoe zawadi kwenye kasa.
sw.Runs the floor and the kitchen: tables a: Inaendesha sehemu ya wageni na kulinishi: meza na oda, menyu, na kisifu cha kulinishi kinachonyesha kilichopikwa.
sw.See what is about to expire, and take th: Ona kile kinachokaribia kumalika, na chukua stocki ya zamani zaidi kwanza.
sw.Sell by the pack, the crate or the kilo,: Uza kwa kifurushi, agabba au kilo, ukirekodi ukubwa wa kifurushi kwenye bidhaa.
sw.Sell on credit against a limit, and see: Uza kwa mikopo dhidi ya kizingiti, na uone kila akaunti inayodaiwa.
sw.Sells by weight and in packs: unit sizes: Anauza kwa uzito na kwa vifurushi: vipimo na ukubwa wa vifurushi kwenye kila bidhaa, misimu ya nyaraka kwa kasa, na bei kwa uzito kwa kaunta.
sw.Sells in volume: tiered prices that drop: Anauza kwa wingi: bei ngazi zinazoshuka kadri idadi inapanda, bei yako mwenyewe ya mteja, na akaunti za mikopo zenye kizingiti.
sw.Send goods out to a shop or a customer a: Tuma bidhaa kwa duka au mteja na ufuatilie usambazaji.
sw.Take a weight from a scale and price the: Chukua uzito kutoka kwenye mizani na panga bei ya bidhaa kwa kilo.
sw.Warn this many days before expiry: Ona siku hizi kabla ya kumalika

lg.A price of your own for a customer, whic: Mutengo gwao gwa buli mukyala, oguzibera emitengo egy'ekisinga.
lg.A price that applies from a certain quan: Mutengo ogujja okukozeseka okuva ku kisinga ekikulu, nga okugula more kugula gwa kila kikumi.
lg.A running list of stock that is close to: Olwandu lw'stocki ekiri ku kumpi okumala, ekisinga ekisinga n'ekisanyusa.
lg.Dispenses medicine safely: batches with: Egula edrugu bulungi: eb-batchi ezirina ennaku z'okumala, emiganda eri muwaambi, n'stocki etoolwa ku ntandikwa okumala.
lg.Find a product at the till by scanning i: Loola kizibu ku kasa ng'okuskana barcode yake, si kuwandika eina.
lg.Fire an order to the kitchen and track i: Sindika order mu kizibu era otraka mu kuyoboka, kuky ready n'okusembwa.
lg.Fire to the kitchen when the order is pa: Sindika mu kizibu order nga esembwa
lg.Follow every order from the moment it is: Soma buli order okuva ku kikyo kisindikwa okutuuka ku kikyo kisembwa.
lg.Keep the menu, mark an item sold out, an: Teekateeka menu, weka alama nga kizibu kyamala, era kikise ku kasa nga kirabika.
lg.Know which batch of which product is on: Maze nga kizibu ki, ek-batchi ki, ku ssiterowa n'ekisinga kisigala.
lg.Open a tab on a table, add to it, and cl: Fumba kadi ku emmeza, yongyezeko ku yo, era uyikale nga emmeza esembwa.
lg.Record the prescriber, dispense against: Andika muwaambi, gula okuva mu batches, era teekateeka ekifaayo.
lg.Run multi-buy and threshold promotions,: Yoola emboozi ez'okugula nyingi n'ez'ekikomo, era omuwa emizigo ku kasa.
lg.Runs the floor and the kitchen: tables a: Yola eka n'ekizibu: emmeza n'emmeka, menu, n'ekizibu ky'ekizini ekw'olaba ekyaliwo okubwa.
lg.See what is about to expire, and take th: Loola ekyakoleka okumala, era giggwa stocki esekadde nnyo.
lg.Sell by the pack, the crate or the kilo,: Zula ku kipake, ekisanduku oba kilo, ng'okurekoda ekikomo ky'ekipake ku kizibu.
lg.Sell on credit against a limit, and see: Zula ku ssaze ng'okujjulwa kikomo, era oluwe buli kikumi ky'asajja.
lg.Sells by weight and in packs: unit sizes: Atunda ku bwanga n'emu mpake: ebipimo by'ekikundu n'ebipimo by'ekipake ku buli kizibu, barcodes ku kasa, n'omutengo ku bwanga ku kaunta.
lg.Sells in volume: tiered prices that drop: Atunda nnyo: emutengo egatukuka nga kisinga kikwata, mutengo gwao gwa buli mukyala, n'ebikumi by'essaze ebikwata kikomo.
lg.Send goods out to a shop or a customer a: Sindika ebizibu eri duuka oba mukyala era otraka okutwala.
lg.Take a weight from a scale and price the: Giggwa bwanga okuva ku mizani era oteekateeke mutengo gwa kizibu ku kilo.
lg.Warn this many days before expiry: Kulanga ennaku ezo nga bwe kumala

fr.A price of your own for a customer, whic: Un prix propre pour un client, qui l'emporte sur les paliers de volume.
fr.A price that applies from a certain quan: Un prix applicable à partir d'une certaine quantité, pour que plus vous achetez, moins chaque unité coûte.
fr.A running list of stock that is close to: Une liste courante du stock proche de l'expiration, le plus ancien en premier.
fr.Allow a price override at the till: Autoriser la modification du prix en caisse
fr.Dispenses medicine safely: batches with: Dispense les médicaments en sécurité : lots avec dates d'expiration, ordonnances avec un prescripteur nommé, et stock sorti dans l'ordre d'expiration.
fr.Find a product at the till by scanning i: Trouvez un produit en caisse en scannant son code-barres au lieu de saisir son nom.
fr.Fire an order to the kitchen and track i: Envoyez une commande en cuisine et suivez-la de la préparation au service.
fr.Fire to the kitchen when the order is pa: Envoyer en cuisine quand la commande est payée
fr.Follow every order from the moment it is: Suivez chaque commande depuis son envoi jusqu'au service.
fr.Keep the menu, mark an item sold out, an: Gérez le menu, marquez un article épuisé et masquez-le en caisse jusqu'à son retour.
fr.Know which batch of which product is on: Sachez quel lot de quel produit est en rayon et combien il en reste.
fr.Open a tab on a table, add to it, and cl: Ouvrez une addition sur une table, ajoutez-y, et fermez-la au moment du règlement.
fr.Record the prescriber, dispense against: Enregistrez le prescripteur, dispensez par lots, et conservez l'enregistrement.
fr.Refuse to sell expired stock: Refuser de vendre du stock expiré
fr.Require a barcode on new products: Exiger un code-barres sur les nouveaux produits
fr.Run multi-buy and threshold promotions,: Lancez les promotions multi-achat et à seuil, et attribuez le lot en caisse.
fr.Runs the floor and the kitchen: tables a: Gère la salle et la cuisine : tables et commandes, un menu, et un écran cuisine qui montre ce qui est en préparation.
fr.See what is about to expire, and take th: Voyez ce qui va bientôt expirer, et sortez le stock le plus ancien en premier.
fr.Sell by the pack, the crate or the kilo,: Vendez au pack, à la caisse ou au kilo, avec la taille du pack enregistrée sur le produit.
fr.Sell on credit against a limit, and see: Vendez à crédit dans la limite fixée, et voyez ce que chaque compte doit.
fr.Sells by weight and in packs: unit sizes: Vend au poids et en packs : tailles unitaires et tailles de pack sur chaque produit, codes-barres pour la caisse, et tarification au poids au comptoir.
fr.Sells in volume: tiered prices that drop: Vend en volume : prix dégressifs selon la quantité, un prix propre pour un client, et des comptes de crédit plafonnés.
fr.Send goods out to a shop or a customer a: Expédiez des marchandises vers une boutique ou un client et suivez la livraison.
fr.Shelf prices include tax: Les prix en rayon sont TTC
fr.Take a weight from a scale and price the: Prenez un poids sur la balance et tarifiez l'article au kilo.
fr.Warn this many days before expiry: Avertir ce nombre de jours avant l'expiration
